_notes: Read by index.html at startup. Each entry in 'dates' is one assessment snapshot; 'params' are the synth args sent at note-on.

To add a snapshot, append an entry to 'dates' (the tuning GUI's 'export JSON entry' button prints one, ready to paste). Dates are YYYY-MM-DD; the page sorts them oldest to newest and opens on the newest.
Keep every snapshot complete (the export is). A param left out of an entry is inherited from the OLDEST entry, so retuning the oldest entry would also change any entry that relies on inheritance.
Optional top-level 'defaultDate' (a 'value' string) opens the page on that date instead of the newest.
lpfOrder is compile-time in make_synthdef.scd; it is listed here only so the response graph matches the synth. Keep them in sync.
UI-owned controls (panMode, toneOn, amp, buf) are intentionally not here. loudnessAmt sets the loudness slider's starting position (the slider shows loudnessAmt / 2).
